description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticSearchClientBuilder class, which generates and configures Elasticsearch clients based on the application's configuration, including methods for sanitizing host URLs, loading configuration from files or global variables, and constructing client instances.

classes.name: ElasticSearchClientBuilder
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to build and configure Elasticsearch client instances, including host sanitization and configuration loading.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a preconfigured Elasticsearch client, loading hosts from configuration if not already set.

methods.name: sanitizeHost
methods.description: Standardizes and validates a host URL or array, ensuring it is suitable for use in Elasticsearch client configuration.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads Elasticsearch host configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: loadFromArray
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of host configurations.

methods.name: loadFromSugarConfig
methods.description: Loads Elasticsearch configuration from the global $sugar_config variable.

methods.name: loadDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides default configuration (localhost) if no other configuration is available.

methods.name: addHttp
methods.description: Ensures a URL has an HTTP or HTTPS scheme, adding 'http://' if missing.
